sources.entry: RELATE - Courseware package that includes features such as: flexible rules, statistics, multi-course support, class calendar. (Source Code) MIT Python

summary.one_liner: RELATE (Environment for Learning And TEaching) is a web-based courseware package for hosting and running courses, with content authored as YAML and Markdown files.
summary.what_it_does: RELATE lets instructors write course content as simple text files based on YAML and Markdown, with content versioned through git integration so instructors can preview new material while students use earlier versions. It supports flexible rules for participation, access, and grading, and multiple courses on one installation. Code questions let students write code in a syntax-highlighted text box, run it in a sandbox, and receive automatic grading, with plotting support and optional second-stage human grading. It also provides a class calendar, grade book, statistics on student answers, live classroom quizzes, and in-class instant messaging via XMPP.
use_cases: host an online course with graded assignments
write course content in Markdown and YAML
run live quizzes in a classroom
manage a class calendar and grade book
how_to_run: See the installation guide linked from the README (not reproduced in the README itself).
notable: Course content authored as plain YAML and Markdown files, versioned through git
Sandboxed execution of student code with automatic grading and plotting support
Multiple courses hosted on the same installation
caveats: Installation requires following a separate installation guide; the README gives no inline setup steps
Platform or hosting requirements are not stated in the README
